summary: pipeline.PIPELINE_AUTH_PASSWORD holds the unexpanded generator expression as a literal string instead of a generated secret, so the public Bull Board is behind a guessable password
evidence: railway variables --service pipeline --kv returns PIPELINE_AUTH_PASSWORD set to the verbatim generator expression text rather than a 44-char random value, while buttery.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (same {generator,preserveExisting} syntax) did expand to real base64. Verified live against https://pipeline-production-41ce.up.railway.app/ui : 401 with no credentials, 200 with basic auth using PIPELINE_AUTH_USER and that literal string. Board exposes every job payload and can retry/promote/delete jobs. Value must be rotated by hand in the dashboard; preserveExisting:true then keeps it.
